Ana: bringing up galaxy-embed-lite-v2 (int8 per-channel) on staging — quick smoke shows a recall@5 drop vs fp16 on short queries, posting eval summary
EmbedBot: eval-job-84621 finished: galaxy-embed-lite-v2 | short-query-holdout | quant=int8-perchannel | status=complete :white_check_mark:
Ana: results below (short-query holdout, 10k queries)
```
Model: galaxy-embed-lite-v2 (int8-perchannel)
Dataset: short-query-holdout (10k)
Recall@1: 0.642 (fp16 baseline 0.655, delta -0.013)
Recall@5: 0.854 (fp16 0.912, delta -0.058)
MRR: 0.731 (fp16 0.765, delta -0.034)
Mean NN dist (cosine): 0.28 (fp16 0.21)
Silhouette (kmeans, 100 clusters): 0.18 (fp16 0.24)
Notes: shortened queries show bigger degradation; top-1 confusions often paraphrase -> anchor mismatch
```
Sara: :eyes: 6% at R@5 is non-trivial. Did you run with L2/norming on? int8 sometimes shifts scale and breaks cosine if not renormalized.\nAna: ran with --normalize True (same as baseline). I also tried --norm-post but results similar.
Josh: can you paste the exact eval command you used?
Ana: `python eval_embeddings.py --model galaxy-embed-lite-v2 --quant int8-perchannel --dataset short-query-holdout --normalize --batch 128 --nprobe 16`
Josh: try increasing nprobe and also run with `--disable-activation-clipping` just to see if kernel clamp is the culprit. Also try int8-per-tensor to compare.
Tomas: I uploaded UMAP snapshot for the run: /shared/embeds/galaxy-v2/int8/umap-shortqueries.png — looks like one cluster got smeared across paraphrase class, silhouette drop visible.
Eva: did tokenization change? sometimes new tokenizer variants create slightly different anchors for short queries.
Ana: tokenizer same as fp16 baseline. ran seed=42.
EmbedBot: quick diff check: length-binned recall delta:
```
len<=8: R@5 delta -0.089
8<len<=20: R@5 delta -0.026
len>20: R@5 delta -0.010
```
EmbedBot: flagged: largest regressions on very short queries (<8 tokens) :warning:\nSara: ok that suggests quantized value dynamics affect short-context embeddings more. Could be bias in the first token projections or layernorm epsilon changes.
Josh: short checklist: 1) run int8-per-tensor vs per-channel 2) try fp16->int8 quant with symmetric vs asymmetric scales 3) test disabling rotary/pos emb fusion 4) run small ablation removing final MLP quantization
Ana: starting parallel runs now. kicking off: `runeval start --config configs/galaxy/int8-parallel.yaml` (will post results)
Tomas: for visualization also run nearest-neighbor distance histograms. if the median distance shifts up that's consistent with lowered cosine similarity.
Ana: quick NN histogram (top1 cos): fp16 median 0.78, int8 median 0.66. Uploaded plot to same folder.
Eva: could we try a tiny calibration dataset for per-channel rescaling? sometimes a small recalibration before serving recovers scale.
Sara: yes try 1k calibration anchors sampled from production short-queries; run per-channel recalib and re-eval.
Ana: noted, doing recalib now. ETA ~15m.
Josh: also add retrieval-side correction: re-normalize vectors at query time as a stopgap. cheaper than re-quantizing model.
Ana: good idea — I'll test re-normalize on client and report R@5 delta.
Tomas: if recalib fixes it, we should add a gating rule: for short-query-heavy customers, prefer fp16 or apply recalib step in deployment pipeline.
Eva: add an eval check to onboarding: length-binned recall thresholds (fail if delta > 0.05 for len<=8).
Ana: adding ticket: ENG-ML#2018 to track (will attach results).
Sara: thanks — keep thread updated. :+1:
Ana: posting updated numbers in 20m. :clock1:
EmbedBot: note: job runcount=3 queued for int8-per-tensor and recalibration configs.
